settings..validate: newData.hasChildren(['chapters','count','mode','createdAt','host']) && newData.child('count').isNumber() && newData.child('count').val() > 0 && newData.child('count').val() <= 999 && (newData.child('mode').val() === 'input' || newData.child('mode').val() === 'select') && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && newData.child('host').isString() && newData.child('chapters').val() != null

$nick..validate: $nick.length >= 1 && $nick.length <= 32 && (!newData.exists() || (newData.hasChildren(['joinedAt','lastActive']) && newData.child('joinedAt').isNumber() && newData.child('lastActive').isNumber() && (!newData.hasChild('clientId') || newData.child('clientId').isString()) && (!newData.hasChild('connected') || newData.child('connected').isBoolean()) && (!data.exists() || newData.child('joinedAt').val() === data.child('joinedAt').val())))

buzz..validate: newData.val() == null || (newData.hasChildren(['nick','time']) && newData.child('nick').isString() && newData.child('time').isNumber() && (!newData.hasChild('remain') || newData.child('remain').isNumber()) && root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/' + newData.child('nick').val()).exists())

selectBuzz..validate: newData.val() == null || (newData.hasChildren(['nick','time']) && newData.child('nick').isString() && newData.child('time').isNumber() && root.child('rooms/' + $roomId + '/players/' + newData.child('nick').val()).exists())
